task.ques: Solve the differential equation y''(t) - 2y'(t) + 10y(t) = 0 and display its general solution.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The general solution is y(t) = e^t[C₁ sin(3t) + C₂ cos(3t)], where C₁ and C₂ are arbitrary constants. WolframAlpha displays this result for y''(t) − 2y'(t) + 10y(t) = 0. Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=solve+y%27%27%28t%29+-+2y%27%28t%29+%2B+10y%28t%29+%3D+0 . Evidence: final.png.
